doc: Hand-derived from spine.gd, not measured (README.md). One 64x64 cell drawn by a custom Node2D whose _draw calls draw_mesh through a runtime CanvasTexture's diffuse (no .tres, no node `texture`, the spine-godot shape). The capture loads at frame 8 and its arm is deferred (GRC_ARM_DEFER_FRAMES) to frame 14, after the CanvasTexture (frame 10) but before the arm, so the capture adopts the CanvasTexture from the canvas_texture_* hooks' registry (the draw's own texture reference), not the node map. Regions are inclusive [x0, y0, x1, y1].
